verdict.rationale: Paddle documents built-in multi-currency support for both payments and payouts, so customers buy in their local currency while you are paid in yours. Localized pricing pages are also documented. Payout reconciliation reports itemize gross, taxes, and fees in both transaction and balance currencies, which gives some FX visibility. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of FX conversion rates, spreads or conversion fees, and independent hands-on corroboration of settlement-currency behavior.
